== Course of events ==

After Jim loses his race against Sawhorse and, in anger, kicks the wooden horse hard enough to break its leg and ear—an act that draws the Hungry Tiger to tackle Jim in retaliation—Princess Ozma responds to the harm done to Sawhorse. She crowns Sawhorse "Prince of Horses" and Tin Woodman undertakes the repair of Sawhorse's broken leg and ear.

The gesture comes once the turmoil surrounding Eureka's trial has settled, Tin Woodman having already produced the duplicate piglet before the jury to answer for the kitten's alleged guilt. By honoring Sawhorse with a princely title while Tin Woodman mends the damage Jim inflicted, this moment closes the episode before the mystery of the missing piglet resurfaces and Dorothy's kitten Eureka is again seen fleeing Princess Ozma's boudoir.
